images.alt: Тенистая площадь и колониальные фасады Койоакана — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Wide 16:9 photorealistic editorial travel illustration for a premium tourism website hero. Coyoacan Mexico City, leafy historic neighborhood cobblestone plaza with warm ochre colonial house facades and simple traditional cafes under mature shade trees. Quiet few authentic contemporary pedestrians in distance. Realistic central Mexican architecture, intimate street view, no skyscrapers, no blue Frida museum facade pretending to be main square, no text or signage. Natural light and realistic textures, quieter uncluttered space on left for white title, composition highlights to right. No text, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset.
